name: Temporary Residence for Education

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a certificate of studying/attending a secondary school or university in Montenegro, plus proof of means of subsistence, accommodation, health insurance, a valid travel document, and a clean criminal record. Minors additionally need parental approval.
requirements.fix_path: Secure school/university enrollment and gather the standard supporting documents.

evidence_required.document: Proof of accommodation and means of subsistence

outcome.duration_length: tied to studies, with extension permitted up to 2 years after completing studies

sources.title: Government of Montenegro (gov.me) -- official temporary-residence categories, including education: enrollment certificate requirement, and a permitted extension of up to 2 years after completing studies

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing, tier 1. GENUINE, DISTINCTIVE FINDING: the up-to-2-year post-graduation extension is a real, sourced feature -- a longer post-study residence window than many comparable routes built elsewhere in this dataset, potentially useful as a bridge into work-based residence, though this build did not confirm a direct legal conversion pathway between the two.
